title_en: AI Deeply Embedded in the U.S. Immigration System, Raising Governance and Compliance Concerns
body_en_md:
## NYU to Hold Conference on AI and Immigration Policy on October 7, Focusing on Ethics and Governance

On October 7, 2026, the New York University Immigration Network will host an all-day conference on AI and immigration policy, co-organized with NYU's Asian/Pacific/American Institute. The conference will run from 9:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Daylight Time and will bring together academics, legal experts, policymakers, and advocates to discuss the use of artificial intelligence in immigration policy, enforcement, and decision-making, including its ethical, legal, and human-rights implications. The program will include three panels and a keynote address. The first panel will examine practical applications of AI in immigration policymaking and enforcement; the second will discuss AI's effects on the public; and the third will explore possible courses of action. The keynote will address the central question of why the definition of AI matters for immigration enforcement and governance.

## AI Is Embedded Throughout U.S. Immigration Enforcement as Experts Warn of Growing Surveillance Risks

AI has moved beyond the conceptual stage and is now deeply embedded in several core parts of the U.S. immigration system. Reports indicate that connections among artificial intelligence, license-plate readers, data brokers, and federal immigration databases are growing. Immigration-rights advocates and privacy experts warn that surveillance technology is rapidly reshaping immigration enforcement nationwide. At a September 10, 2026 media briefing hosted by ethnic and community media in the United States, experts from organizations including the Electronic Frontier Foundation, the American Immigration Council, and the American Civil Liberties Union said immigration enforcement had developed an integrated surveillance ecosystem spanning federal, state, local, and commercial data flows. It can track people's movements and identify behavioral patterns, substantially lowering the threshold for enforcement agencies to locate target populations. Immigration agencies have also deployed algorithmic screening tools in visa adjudication, despite a lack of transparency and effective oversight.

In a September 7, 2026 speech in Geneva, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk publicly warned that advanced AI could pose an “existential” risk to humanity. He also raised concerns about U.S. immigration enforcement, disclosing that approximately 23 deaths had occurred in U.S. immigration detention facilities this year. He expressed serious concern over plans to equip enforcement officers with electric-shock gloves and called for accountability. The Department of Homeland Security responded that it was committed to ensuring detention conditions were safe, compliant, and humane. Its Office of Inspector General was investigating deaths in detention dating back to October 2021.

## Tighter Immigration Policies and Expanding Technology Directly Affect Multiple Groups

The expansion of AI in immigration is compounding the effects of recent immigration-policy changes under the Trump administration, directly affecting the rights of several groups. Undocumented immigrants, visa applicants, and asylum seekers are among those most directly affected. The expanding integrated surveillance ecosystem allows multiple agencies to share these groups' travel and communications data, increasing the risk that they will be located and deported. Algorithmic screening tools also make visa applications less predictable and may increase the possibility of denials without clear reasons.

Immigration lawyers and members of advocacy organizations also face enforcement risks. One report described an immigration attorney who had publicly criticized U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) online and on television. The attorney's phone was confiscated upon entering the country at an airport, and the attorney later obtained a temporary restraining order. At a broader level, recent Trump administration immigration actions have shifted the focus of deportations from the southern border to the U.S. interior, while suspending asylum applications from dozens of countries, freezing visa processing, revoking Temporary Protected Status, and increasing student and work visa fees. These measures have reportedly contributed to a contraction of approximately 1 million workers in the U.S. labor market and a 29% decline in student visa issuances. Agriculture, technology, and service industries that rely on immigrant labor face staffing shortages, while barriers to the arrival of highly skilled workers threaten long-term economic growth.

## Academic and Policy Communities Step Up Their Response, with Key Rules and Milestones to Watch

Academics and policymakers have begun responding to the risks associated with AI in immigration. NYU's October 7, 2026 conference will include a dedicated session on possible courses of action, and its findings may inform future regulation. Education has already begun adjusting its training priorities. Princeton's School of Public and International Affairs introduced four courses related to AI and global policy for the fall 2026 semester. The courses identify algorithmic auditing, data contracts, and cross-border analysis as core skills for public administration. Princeton has also established a task force focused on immigration policy to study how immigration policy should adapt to technological change and address gaps in public-sector expertise in technology oversight and immigration management.

Several developments warrant attention: discussions at the UN Human Rights Council are scheduled to conclude on October 7, with progress on AI risks and immigrant rights to be watched; the findings of the DHS Office of Inspector General's investigation into immigration-detention deaths since October 2021; the implementation of the Trump administration's immigration-policy changes; and any federal regulatory rules governing the use of AI in immigration enforcement.

Different groups can prepare according to their circumstances. Immigration-rights organizations can follow the conference's recommendations and adjust their advocacy priorities. Immigration attorneys can monitor compliance reviews of algorithmic screening tools and tailor services to clients. Visa applicants can watch for policy notices and prepare application materials in advance. Employers that depend on immigrant labor can assess potential staffing gaps and adjust hiring and workforce plans.

title_en: Elon Musk's Daughter Vivian Wilson Fronts Anti-AI Fashion Campaign, Criticizing Her Father's Obsession with Artificial Intelligence
body_en_md:
On September 12, 2026, Spanish fashion brand Desigual officially released images and campaign information for its fall 2026 collection, “Born to Disobey.” Public materials identified Vivian Wilson as the face of the campaign. Its release came as public discussion of AI's growing presence in everyday life and emotional relationships reached a high point. Wilson's position in the campaign was interpreted by some observers as a direct response to her father Elon Musk's recent public statements and behavior. The event went beyond a commercial endorsement: the family context prompted broader discussion of technology ethics, identity, and the relationship between public figures' private lives and public images.

Looking at the timeline, public interactions between Vivian Wilson and Elon Musk did not begin with this campaign. Wilson had previously established her identity as a transgender woman through her public life. This process of self-identification unfolded while her father was working to advance artificial-intelligence technology, creating a contrast in their respective public trajectories. On September 12, 2026, Desigual released a fashion campaign framed as anti-AI, at a time when Musk's public attention was widely seen as having shifted substantially toward AI-related matters. The material describes AI projects, including matters related to Grok, as central to Musk's current public image, while his earlier involvement in rocket manufacturing and automobile production had become less prominent in public discussion. This shift in business focus forms part of the context for Wilson's decision to speak out at this time.

Desigual's fall 2026 campaign was titled “Born to Disobey.” Wilson served as its face. Rather than discussing AI technical specifications or algorithmic details, the advertising conveyed its message through imagery and the expression of a position. It criticized AI and robotics, suggesting that these fields were becoming substitutes for emotional relationships for some people. This statement was linked to public observations about Musk's personal interests. The material described Musk as wanting an AI girlfriend “very much,” reflecting public attention to his personal life. Wilson's appearance in the advertisement was consequently given a dual meaning: a public expression of her own identity and a response to her father's current behavior. Public disagreements within the family have appeared in media coverage before, but the focus on AI gave this episode a specific subject.

From the perspective of the brand and its official messaging, Desigual's choice of theme may have been related to contemporary cultural concerns about AI. However, the material provides no further strategic explanation from the brand and no specific market-response data or sales targets. The campaign was classified as a fashion campaign, but its message went beyond ordinary commercial promotion. For consumers, the news provides information about the theme of a fashion campaign, not purchasing guidance or product details. For people following AI, Wilson's position offers a nontechnical comment on possible uses of AI, including emotional substitution. The material, however, mentions no specific policy changes, technical-standard revisions, or market-response data, making the campaign's actual impact difficult to quantify.

Against this background, public attention to the Musk family's activities continued to grow. An incident aboard an American Airlines flight on September 4, 2026, had previously stirred public discussion. A passenger reportedly became concerned after seeing online chat records involving a minor on a neighboring passenger's laptop screen and notified the crew. According to images, the passenger—identified in some accounts as Jim Thornton—used a phone to look up Google AI search results immediately after crew members asked him to close the laptop. Accounts did not consistently identify the person involved, but the incident reflected heightened sensitivity in early September 2026 to AI search content and online behavior. It occurred only eight days before the Desigual campaign was released, illustrating the scrutiny surrounding AI-related conduct at the time.

Family legal matters involving public figures were also frequently in the news, forming part of the same social context. On September 2, 2026, Robert Gross filed a lawsuit against McKenna in Alaska. Court documents said Gross claimed that he and McKenna had never married but had a son together, Cassius West, born in 2021. As the child's biological father, Gross was engaged in a legal dispute with the child's biological parents over custody and related matters. NFL player Aaron Donald also filed court documents in early September 2026. Several weeks before the NFL season began, he asked a court to grant him primary custody of his two minor children before a dog was removed from his former partner Jaelynn Blakey's home. Donald said he feared the dog could harm the children. These family legal disputes in early September, together with Wilson's public campaign, formed part of the subjects attracting attention in mid-September and reflected public interest in celebrity family relationships, custody, and personal boundaries.

In entertainment and culture, a dispute involving musicians Macklemore and Ed Sheeran and Robert Kraft continued to develop on September 20, 2026. Mark Geragos and Harvey Levin publicly argued over who was the “bad guy” in the episode. Levin accused Macklemore of having a history of antisemitism and argued that Kraft had the right to kick the rapper out of his home. These conflicts among public figures further illustrated the unprecedented scrutiny of celebrities' statements and moral positions during September 2026. Miley Cyrus's public image also changed during the same period. Compared with her deep-neckline outfit and short hairstyle at the 2012 VMAs, when she was 19, Cyrus in 2026 had received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame and released her latest album, “Bass Persuades,” that week. Calvin Klein's Euphoria fragrance campaign with Rosalía also appeared around September 12, 2026. After the Calvin Klein Collection runway show, Rosalía said the Euphoria brand brought back specific memories. The new campaign moved away from the previous style of muscular male models and glossy chests toward imagery with greater intensity and concentration.

Returning to Wilson's campaign, the groups most directly affected are people following the Musk family's activities and those interested in AI ethics and cultural influence. Desigual's choice of theme may have reflected contemporary concerns about AI, but the material provides no further strategic explanation from the brand. One risk in interpreting the event is to treat it simply as commercial promotion and overlook the personal position it may express. At the same time, the material provides only partial descriptions of Musk's personal life, and observers should avoid speculation about unverified details.

What happens next depends on how the public interprets the event. If it is viewed as a public-relations campaign for a fashion collection, Desigual and Wilson may continue the associated promotional schedule. The material calls it a “fall 2026 fashion campaign,” suggesting that it is part of seasonal marketing. Those following the Musk family may watch for further public appearances by Wilson or a response from Musk. However, the material gives no specific timetable for follow-up events, interviews, or official statements. The observable indicators for now are the campaign's reach on social media and in fashion media, and whether additional interviews or content are released. Further details will require public information from the parties involved rather than speculation.

title_en: August Visa Bulletin Retrogresses Across the Board as Employment-Based Immigration in FY2026 Rises Before Falling
body_en_md:
The U.S. Department of State's monthly Visa Bulletin is the only official timetable that employment-based and investor-immigrant applicants can use to judge when they may file an I-485 application for adjustment of status and when they may receive a green card. Since the beginning of 2026, the timetable has followed a pattern of early gains followed by setbacks. Several categories advanced during the first months of the year, and some analyses even suggested that certain applicants could file for permanent residence earlier than expected. But the August Visa Bulletin led multiple reports to the same conclusion: every employment-based (EB) preference category experienced significant retrogression. For hundreds of thousands of people waiting in line, this means their expected timelines have been pushed back, making this a critical time to review documents and adjust filing plans.

## First Half of 2026: Forward Movement, Divergence, and Then Broad Retrogression

Looking at the months published so far this year, the pattern is clear. The January Visa Bulletin was described as bringing “more progress in the new year,” with several categories advancing that month. The April bulletin showed pronounced divergence. One law firm's summary described it as “drought for some categories and spring rain for others”: applicants in different preference categories and from different countries of birth experienced very different outcomes in the same month. Some advanced substantially, while others remained in place or moved backward. The June bulletin was then published as part of the monthly schedule. By August, the direction had changed fundamentally, with all EB preference categories retrogressing together.

One difference in how reports characterize the situation should be noted. Media outlets and law firms emphasized “divergence” when describing the April bulletin, while their descriptions of the August bulletin consistently pointed to “across-the-board retrogression.” In other words, the claim that visa availability deteriorated throughout 2026 applies only to the second half of the year; the first half was mixed. Readers who look only at headlines may get the impression that the system tightened continuously, which does not fully match the month-by-month picture.

## Why Did Retrogression Occur in August?

The Visa Bulletin is not an administrative order; it is a scorecard for visa-number consumption. U.S. immigration quotas are allocated by federal fiscal year, which begins on October 1. The number of visas available each year is fixed for each category and country. At the beginning of a fiscal year, inventory is relatively plentiful, and priority dates can generally move forward. This helps explain the progress seen in January and April. As the fiscal year advances, visa numbers are gradually used up, and the State Department may have to retrogress dates to limit the pace of filings and green-card approvals. August was already close to the end of fiscal year 2026. Across-the-board retrogression at that point is a typical response to quotas nearing exhaustion, rather than a policy shift targeting a particular group of applicants.

At the same time, another issue was influencing the investor-immigration field: discussions increasingly linked the future of EB-5 with the proposed “Gold Card” program. The Gold Card is an investment-based residency concept put forward by the current administration. The central debate is whether it would replace, divert applicants from, or operate alongside the existing EB-5 program. These discussions remain at the proposal and outlook stage and have not yet produced a specific change in the Visa Bulletin. Nevertheless, they directly affect the decision facing people considering investor immigration: whether to invest in EB-5 now or wait for a new proposal.

## Who Is Most Affected, and What Mistakes Should Applicants Avoid?

Three groups are most directly affected. The first consists of applicants who have already filed I-485 applications and are waiting for visa availability. Retrogression means their priority dates may no longer be current for the month, pushing back the overall timing of green-card approval. People relying on their I-485 status for work authorization and travel in and out of the United States need to pay particular attention to extension schedules.

The second group consists of applicants who have not yet filed but had estimated, based on the first-half trend, that they could file this year. The August retrogression invalidates that expectation. This is especially relevant to applicants in categories that had advanced quickly and who had recently been told they might be able to file earlier than expected. Preparing documents according to the old timeline could leave them waiting an additional month.

The third group includes EB-5 investors and employers managing priority dates for foreign employees. Retrogression can force employers to extend plans for retaining workers and coordinating work visas.

There are two common mistakes to avoid. First, do not treat a single month's forward movement as a trend. Before filing, check both the current Visa Bulletin and the USCIS chart designated for that month—whether the “Final Action Dates” chart or the “Dates for Filing” chart applies. Second, do not focus only on the overall direction of a category while overlooking country of birth. Differences in visa backlogs between countries within the same category can be much greater than differences between categories. Applicants born in countries with high visa demand, such as China and India, generally wait longer. Progress for someone else may not mean progress for you.

## What to Watch and What to Do Now

There are three clear milestones. First, check the next month's Visa Bulletin in the first part of each month. The September bulletin will show whether the August retrogression continues and provide the first indication of whether this round of retrogression is a final-year push or a sustained tightening. Second, the new federal fiscal year begins on October 1, when category quotas reset. Historically, this is often a point when visa availability regains some room to move. If retrogression stops in September, the first bulletin of the new fiscal year will deserve close attention. Third, the policy direction of the Gold Card program and EB-5 will determine whether investor immigration undergoes a structural change.

Practical steps now include comparing your priority date with the latest Visa Bulletin and confirming which chart applies for the month. If you are waiting for I-485 approval, check whether your employment authorization and advance parole documents remain valid for the extended waiting period. If you have not filed, reschedule your document checklist—including the I-140 approval notice, medical examination, and employer support documents—assuming a delay of at least one quarter. Applicants considering investor immigration should avoid making an irreversible investment decision based solely on a single month's Visa Bulletin before the relationship between the Gold Card and EB-5 becomes clearer.

title_en: I-395 Fleeing Vehicle Crash Leaves 3 Dead and 1 Seriously Injured
body_en_md:
On September 27, 2026, a serious traffic crash occurred on an I-395 highway exit ramp in Arlington County, Virginia, leaving 3 people dead and 1 seriously injured. The crash occurred during a police pursuit involving a stolen vehicle. The vehicle lost control and crashed on the exit ramp, causing multiple casualties among its occupants. Local law enforcement is investigating. The scene has largely been cleared, the injured person is receiving medical treatment, and the precise cause of the crash and allocation of responsibility remain under investigation. The central facts are that a stolen vehicle collided on an I-395 exit ramp while being pursued by police, killing 3 occupants at the scene and sending another person to a hospital in critical condition. The crash occurred during a period of local traffic activity. Traffic was temporarily affected, and police and transportation authorities subsequently carried out traffic controls and an on-site investigation.

Based on the known facts, this was not simply a collision caused by a traffic violation. It was directly connected to a police pursuit of a stolen vehicle. The stolen vehicle continued moving after police became involved and ultimately lost control on the exit ramp, resulting in a severe impact. Emergency responders quickly began treating those involved. Three people were confirmed dead, and the seriously injured person was taken to a hospital for critical care. Accounts from different sources have centered on the core result of “3 dead and 1 seriously injured.” The precise collision configuration, number of vehicles, and whether there were other victims have not been established, and no separate casualty figures have been reported.

I-395 in the Arlington area is an important route connecting communities around Washington, D.C. Its exit ramps carry substantial traffic as vehicles enter and leave the highway. A high-energy collision on this type of roadway can cause casualties and disrupt nearby traffic. After a crash, the relevant agencies need to inspect the scene, collect evidence, obtain driving-recorder and surveillance footage, and analyze multiple factors, including vehicle condition, driver behavior, and road conditions. When a crash occurs during a police pursuit, an investigation generally also examines where the stolen vehicle came from, how the pursuit decision was made, whether on-scene risk-avoidance measures were adequate, and how legal responsibility should ultimately be allocated.

Several groups are directly affected. First are the people involved and their families. The identities and subsequent condition of the 3 people who died and the 1 seriously injured person have not yet been fully disclosed. Their families are facing the sudden impact of these casualties. Second are other drivers and passengers in the surrounding area. Normal traffic on the I-395 exit ramp and nearby roads was disrupted, potentially causing congestion or temporary traffic controls. Passing vehicles may have had to detour or wait for the scene to be cleared. Third are local law-enforcement and traffic-management agencies, which must devote resources to the investigation, scene clearance, traffic management, and subsequent safety analysis. Fourth is the public, especially people concerned about road safety and police-pursuit policies. Such crashes often prompt debate about the safety limits of pursuits, risk management, and whether decisions made at the scene were reasonable.

Based on information disclosed so far, the key details are the date—September 27, 2026—the location—an I-395 exit ramp in Arlington—the outcome—3 dead and 1 seriously injured—and the context of a police pursuit involving a stolen vehicle. Public information has focused mainly on the outcome and basic circumstances. Authorities have not yet provided authoritative details about the collision mechanics, speed, vehicle models, or whether other vehicles were involved. Investigators generally reconstruct events using physical evidence, vehicle damage, dashcam and surveillance video, and witness statements. This process takes time, particularly when multiple parties and a police pursuit are involved.

For ordinary drivers, the crash is a reminder to control speed, maintain a safe following distance, and watch for unusual vehicles or sudden hazards on highway exit ramps, where traffic merges and speeds change frequently. For police and traffic-management agencies, controlling risks during a pursuit is essential. They must weigh the need to apprehend suspects against the danger to innocent members of the public. The investigation may also provide a basis for later reviews of pursuit policies and on-scene procedures. For the local community, a serious sudden crash can cause short-term psychological effects and travel disruption. Nearby residents and commuters should follow official notices about road reopening and traffic diversions.

Investigators will continue examining the cause of the crash, including the stolen vehicle's origin, when the pursuit began and ended, whether other factors contributed, and how responsibility should be determined. The seriously injured person's treatment and condition will be important developments. Confirming the identities of those who died and notifying their families are also part of the follow-up process. Traffic on the I-395 exit ramp and nearby roads will return to normal as the scene investigation progresses. Drivers can use official traffic notices to check for temporary restrictions or detours. Anyone seeking further details should follow updates from law-enforcement and transportation agencies rather than rely on scattered, unverified reports.

The central facts of this crash are relatively clear: on September 27, 2026, a stolen vehicle collided during a police pursuit on an I-395 exit ramp in Arlington, leaving 3 people dead and 1 seriously injured. The main outstanding issues are the investigation's findings, including the cause, allocation of responsibility, and whether other legal questions are involved. Traffic restoration, treatment of the seriously injured person, and matters concerning those who died will also continue to develop. Drivers and others traveling through the area should pay attention to short-term road conditions and official traffic guidance. For people following road safety and police-pursuit issues, the crash will serve as a specific case for examining the safety limits and procedures of police pursuits.

title_en: Africa's Wealthiest Monarch Says an Attack on Saudi Arabia Is an Attack on His Kingdom
body_en_md:
## Core Event and Official Statement

The monarch described as the wealthiest in Africa has publicly declared that any attack on Saudi Arabia would be equivalent to an attack on his own kingdom. The statement directly links Saudi security interests with the position of one of Africa's wealthiest monarchies. It suggests that an attack on the Red Sea region or Saudi territory could broaden a geopolitical conflict to involve, indirectly, an African center of wealth. Multiple media reports said the declaration came amid continued Houthi pressure on Saudi Arabia, reflecting the intersection of security and economic interests between major Gulf economies and important African economic actors.

An analysis by the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace said the effects of Houthi advances could extend well beyond Saudi Arabia. The Red Sea is a critical route connecting the Middle East, the Horn of Africa, and global trade networks. Changes in its security situation affect not only Saudi oil logistics but also African coastal countries that depend on maritime trade. The Council on Foreign Relations has emphasized that the conflict between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia has direct significance for the United States: disruption to Red Sea shipping can affect global energy supplies and the security of maritime routes, with consequences for U.S. diplomatic strategy in the Middle East and the Horn of Africa.

## Red Sea Tensions and Effects on Shipping and Energy

Security conditions in the Red Sea are the immediate driver behind the statement. CNBC Africa reported that oil prices rose after Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, indicating that concerns about disruption to the Red Sea route and the security of Saudi oil facilities were being transmitted into energy prices. Bloomberg further reported that Saudi oil logistics had again been disrupted by Houthi threats in the Red Sea, creating uncertainty for tanker operations and port scheduling. Bloomberg and gCaptain also reported that Saudi vessels were taking an unusual route around Africa to avoid the Red Sea chokepoint, suggesting that Saudi Arabia was adjusting shipping routes to reduce the risk of attacks.

These route changes have practical consequences for traders and businesses that rely on the Red Sea. Countries around the Horn of Africa, including Djibouti and Somalia, are affected by the Saudi-Houthi conflict. Firstpost reported that the Red Sea war between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis had placed a burden on Djibouti and Somalia and prompted Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to seek assistance from Egyptian President Sisi. This shows that changes in Red Sea security affect not only Saudi logistics and energy exports but also port economies and regional stability in East Africa.

## Saudi Arabia's Economic and Strategic Position in Africa

Saudi Arabia's economic engagement with Africa is increasing, providing structural context for the monarch's statement linking his kingdom to Saudi Arabia. According to research cited in the material, trade between Saudi Arabia and Africa was estimated at approximately $45 billion in 2022. In November 2023, Saudi Arabia held its first Saudi-Africa Summit, announcing several funding and cooperation commitments. These included plans to provide $25 billion by 2030, $5 billion from the Saudi Fund for Development, $500 million in debt relief from the Ministry of Finance, and approximately 50 agreements across different sectors. The arrangements were intended to strengthen Saudi Arabia's economic presence across the continent and align with the African Union's Agenda 2063.

Saudi investment in Africa covers several sectors. ACWA (formerly ACWA Power), a leading Saudi company in renewable energy, is developing large solar and wind projects in Egypt, Morocco, and South Africa, while also working in seawater desalination and green hydrogen production. In December 2025, ACWA signed a cooperation framework with the African Development Bank to support financing for a clean-energy and water-project pipeline worth $5 billion through 2030. ACWA also describes itself as the world's largest private desalination company. The Saudi Public Investment Fund is pursuing related initiatives, including exploring new port construction in some African countries and developing port infrastructure in the Horn of Africa to facilitate exports of African products to Saudi Arabia.

## Capital Flows and the Competitive Landscape

Saudi Arabia's economic engagement with Africa is not one-way; it takes place amid competition with the United Arab Emirates. Abu Dhabi's Mubadala and Abu Dhabi Investment Authority sovereign wealth funds, Dubai's DP World—which operates ports in several African countries—and Abu Dhabi's Masdar, which develops renewable-energy projects across Africa, all have established substantial presences on the continent. Saudi-Emirati competition in Africa broadly echoes their rivalry in the Gulf. Both countries want to become the preferred Gulf partner for African governments and businesses by providing capital, trade ties, and diplomatic support. This competition is constructive in many cases, but can also create friction when the two sides seek the same assets or relationships.

Saudi exposure and country risk vary significantly across African countries. The figures cited for Saudi exposure are approximately $8.5 billion in Egypt, where political stability and regulatory risk are both medium and the investment climate is moderate; $3.2 billion in South Africa, where political stability is medium, regulatory risk is low to medium, and the investment climate is favorable; $1.8 billion in Nigeria, where political stability is medium to high, regulatory risk is high, and the investment climate is moderate; $1.2 billion in Kenya, where political stability is medium and the investment climate is favorable; $1 billion in Morocco, where political stability and regulatory risk are both low and the investment climate is favorable; $900 million in Tanzania, where political stability is medium to low and the investment climate is improving; $700 million in Ethiopia, where political stability is high, regulatory risk is high, and the investment climate is challenging; $500 million in Senegal, where political stability and regulatory risk are both low and the investment climate is favorable; $850 million in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where political stability and regulatory risk are both very high and the investment climate is poor; and $600 million in Zambia, where political stability is medium and the investment climate is improving. These figures show that Saudi capital allocation and risk assessments differ substantially by country.

## Development Assistance and a Shift in Soft Power

Beyond major investments and trade, Saudi Arabia's engagement with Africa includes long-term development assistance and a shift in soft-power strategy. Research cited in the material indicates that Saudi Arabia implemented 438 development-assistance projects in 15 West African countries between 2015 and 2024, covering education, agriculture, health, energy, water, and infrastructure. The Saudi Fund for Development supported road and water projects in Senegal and Niger, improving transportation networks and access to basic services. Saudi rural well-drilling and development programs also expanded access to clean drinking water in several West African countries. In Guinea, Saudi Arabia funded an approximately $8 million water project involving 140 wells and solar pumps to reduce drought pressure on rural communities. In 2022, the Islamic Development Bank inaugurated the Dongka Hospital in Kankan. During a 2021 Paris conference, Saudi Arabia announced an approximately $1 billion development-investment package for initiatives in education, security, industry, finance, agriculture, fisheries, mining, transport, and energy in Nigeria and other African countries.

Saudi Arabia's soft-power strategy in Africa is also changing. Historically, Riyadh's influence was exercised mainly through religious channels, including the promotion of Wahhabi Islam, against the backdrop of efforts to counter Iran's expanding Shiite influence in Africa. This approach relied on religious institutions, charitable assistance, and mosque construction, seeking to position Saudi Arabia as the spiritual center of the Islamic world. Under Mohammed bin Salman, the approach has changed. The “moderate Islam” promoted under Vision 2030 signals an effort to reduce the emphasis on religious outreach and instead express soft power through economic engagement, summit diplomacy, and cultural exports such as sports. The Saudi-Arab-African Economic Conference held in Riyadh in 2023 brought together leaders from more than 50 Middle Eastern and African countries to deepen political ties, expand trade cooperation, and support the African Union's entry into the G20. A new Africa summit in 2024 further positioned Saudi Arabia as a credible African partner and political stakeholder. Saudi Arabia has also expanded its influence through “sports diplomacy,” including football investment, event bids, and infrastructure projects.

## Practical Effects on Different Groups and What to Watch Next

These developments have different practical implications for different groups. For shipping and logistics businesses that depend on the Red Sea route, Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and threats to the Red Sea may continue to prompt vessels to reroute, increasing transit times and costs and creating uncertainty around insurance and scheduling. For energy-market participants, disruptions to Saudi oil logistics and volatility in the Red Sea could continue to put upward pressure on oil prices. Markets will need to watch whether Saudi oil-export routes are adjusted further. For companies operating in trade, energy, infrastructure, or ports in Africa, competition between Saudi Arabia and the UAE may create additional capital and project opportunities. Businesses will also need to assess differences in political stability, regulatory risk, and investment conditions, especially in higher-risk countries such as Ethiopia, Nigeria, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

For businesses and observers in countries around the Horn of Africa, the Saudi-Houthi conflict may continue to affect port economies and the regional security environment in Djibouti and Somalia, while prompting Saudi Arabia to coordinate more closely with countries such as Egypt. Those following Saudi development assistance and project implementation should monitor channels such as the Saudi Fund for Development, the Islamic Development Bank, and the ACWA-African Development Bank cooperation framework, which are important routes for actual funding and project delivery. Subsequent project progress, financing arrangements, and implementation details will need to be monitored.

Key issues to watch include whether Red Sea security deteriorates further; whether Saudi vessels' rerouting becomes routine; whether disruptions to oil logistics continue to affect energy prices and transportation; whether the Saudi-Houthi conflict leads to more regional diplomatic coordination, particularly a clearer mechanism for cooperation between Saudi Arabia and Egypt on Red Sea security and Horn of Africa affairs; whether Saudi investment and aid commitments in Africa—including funding planned by 2030, the $5 billion ACWA-African Development Bank project pipeline, and specific projects financed through the Saudi Fund for Development and Islamic Development Bank—are implemented and produce verifiable progress; and whether Saudi-UAE competition in Africa creates friction in particular countries or projects that affects the investment environment and project allocation.

Overall, the central issue is the wealthy African monarch's statement linking Saudi security to his own kingdom's interests, and the relationship among Red Sea tensions, energy logistics, shipping-route changes, and Saudi Arabia's expanding economic and diplomatic presence in Africa. For participants in shipping, energy, infrastructure, and local African businesses, the key is to keep tracking changes in Red Sea security, adjustments to Saudi oil logistics and shipping routes, and the delivery of Saudi-funded projects and country-specific risk developments across Africa.

title_en: watchOS 27.0.1 Update Expands to More Models as Patent Loss and New Watches Arrive
body_en_md:
Apple has recently made two moves in its Apple Watch lineup. It released the watchOS 27.0.1 software update for some models that had not previously been included, while also introducing new hardware and dealing with an adverse ruling in a haptic-feedback patent case. Consumers are weighing which model to choose and whether to update, while Apple faces a legal bill. For ordinary buyers, decisions about which watch to purchase and whether to update mainly depend on the model they already own, how much they value changes to the frequency of heart-rate and health monitoring, and whether they are willing to wait longer for new features.

## Which Devices Are Covered by the Software Update?

watchOS 27.0.1 is a follow-up release for models that had not previously received the update. Multiple media reports said the purpose was not to introduce an entirely new set of features, but to extend the basic watchOS 27 update to more Apple Watch models so that devices that might otherwise have remained on older software could join the same update cycle.

For users, this has a direct effect on two groups. The first includes people who already own an older Apple Watch but had not been able to receive watchOS 27. They can now use the software update to bring their watches into the same system environment. The second includes people who have just bought a new watch but are concerned about software stability. As an update extended to more models, version 27.0.1 may indicate that some compatibility or stability issues in earlier versions have been addressed to some degree.

The material does not provide a complete change log, a definitive list of supported models, or details on whether the update changes the availability of particular features. For owners of specific older models, the conclusion that can be confirmed is that the release itself shows Apple extending watchOS 27 coverage further, rather than all models automatically being on the same version.

## Key Changes in the New Hardware

At the same time, Apple unveiled the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 on September 9, 2026. Both models feature the new Health Sensing System and S11 chip. Apple's official materials emphasized the accuracy and frequency of heart-rate sensing. The ECG component in the Series 12 uses 32 electrodes, compared with 2 in the Series 11. The optical sensors and LED efficiency were also described as improvements that help increase the accuracy of heart-rate readings.

Health-data sampling frequency has also changed. The Series 12 says it records heart rate every 5 seconds and can record heart-rate variability (HRV) as often as every 5 minutes. By comparison, the Series 11 records heart rate every 5 minutes and HRV approximately every 2 hours. The Series 12 also introduces a Readiness score, which uses recent health and activity data to provide a reference for a user's physical readiness that day. Audio Intelligence is another important addition, but two features—Live Rewind and Siri Recap—were not immediately available at the time and were listed as coming later that year.

For battery life and charging, the Series 12 is still rated for up to 24 hours of normal use and up to 38 hours in Low Power Mode. Charging is faster: 15 minutes of charging can support approximately 12 hours of regular use, while 5 minutes can support approximately 10 hours of sleep tracking. The Ultra 4 is aimed at sports and outdoor use, with a claimed maximum of 45 hours of outdoor workout tracking and more accurate on-device GPS.

In terms of positioning, Apple's main U.S. product lineup can currently be understood in three tiers: the SE 3 as the entry-level option, the Series 11 as the previous mainstream model, and the Ultra 3 for people who need a larger case, longer battery life, satellite connectivity, and diving-related capabilities. The addition of the Series 12 and Ultra 4 gives the mainstream and high-end lines updates centered on health sensing and the chip.

## Financial Pressure from the Patent Ruling

Alongside the hardware updates, Apple is also facing a substantial patent judgment. Multiple media outlets cited the same case and reported that Apple was ordered to pay $5.7 billion over haptic-feedback patents involving the iPhone and Apple Watch. The amount is $5.7 billion and concerns a patent-infringement ruling involving Apple's hardware product lines.

For Apple, the immediate significance is first a legal and financial liability, and only secondarily a product issue. Haptic feedback is a technology used in the interaction experience of both iPhones and Apple Watches. As a result, although the ruling appears to be a legal dispute, its potential scope may extend beyond one watch model to the interaction design and patent use of related hardware products. For ordinary consumers, the judgment does not directly change how their watches work and does not mean that a feature on an already purchased device will immediately stop functioning. It is, however, a company-level issue Apple must address at the same time.

The material does not provide the stage of the proceedings, whether an appeal has been filed, the specific patent numbers, or the range of affected models. It also does not say whether the full amount will ultimately be enforced. What can be stated for now is the reported judgment amount and the technology involved—haptic feedback in the iPhone and Apple Watch—not the subsequent legal outcome.

## What Different Users Should Pay Attention To

For people who already use an Apple Watch, the most immediate step is to check whether their model is covered by watchOS 27.0.1. If they had not previously upgraded to watchOS 27, this release for additional models provides an opportunity to catch up with the basic software version. If they are already using a newer system, they should consult Apple's subsequent explanations to determine whether 27.0.1 contains fixes relevant to their use.

For people considering a new watch, the main differences between the Series 12 and Ultra 4 involve health-sensing frequency, the number of ECG electrodes, battery-life targets, GPS and outdoor capabilities, and whether the new Readiness metric is useful to them. The Series 12 starts at $399 in the United States. The Ultra 4 is aimed at users with greater demands for sports and outdoor capabilities. By comparison, the GPS version of the SE 3 starts at $249, the GPS + Cellular version starts at $299, and the Ultra 3 starts at $799. The material also mentions that the GPS + Cellular version of the Ultra 3 had been discounted to $699 from $799. This indicates that prices within the same product line can vary by retailer and timing, so buyers should confirm the actual listed price before ordering.

The new models may be more appealing to users who particularly value frequent heart-rate and HRV readings, changes in the number of ECG electrodes, the Readiness score, or future Audio Intelligence features. Users who mainly want basic functions and are more price-sensitive may still find the SE 3 a lower-cost option in the current lineup. For people who rarely engage in extreme outdoor activities and do not rely on satellite connectivity, the product comparison in the material also suggests that the Series 11 or updated Series 12 may already cover most everyday needs.

## What Comes Next?

Some developments have a clear schedule. watchOS 27.0.1 has been released for additional models, and the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 have been unveiled. They became available in stores on September 18, 2026, in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, India, Japan, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, the United States, and more than 50 other countries and regions. The Series 12 starts at $399 in the United States. Apple also said at the time that a redesigned Health app for iPhone would arrive later that year.

Other matters remain unresolved. Live Rewind and Siri Recap, part of Audio Intelligence, were listed at the time as coming later in the year. This means that some audio-related capabilities mentioned in promotional materials were not available immediately on launch day. As for the patent ruling, the $5.7 billion figure has been reported, but the material contains no subsequent appeal developments, enforcement arrangements, or specific legal timeline. For now, it can only be treated as a disclosed judgment amount; any change will depend on later judicial proceedings.

For ordinary users, the next steps are not about following one media outlet's account, but about three practical questions: whether their Apple Watch can now update to watchOS 27.0.1; whether they need to wait for the Health app and Audio Intelligence features to arrive; and whether the model and price they are considering have changed. For people simply deciding which model is the better purchase now, the current basis for comparison is product positioning, differences in health sensing, and charging performance—not features that have not yet arrived or legal developments that remain uncertain.

title_en: Two Giant Pandas Arrive at Zoo Atlanta; Public Viewing Must Wait Under New 10-Year Partnership
body_en_md:
Two giant pandas arrived in Atlanta, Georgia, on September 27, 2026, and entered a new panda-specific area at Zoo Atlanta. Their arrival ended the zoo's two-year period without pandas. The pair consists of Ping Ping, a 6-year-old male, and Fu Shuang, a 5-year-old female; both were born in 2020. They departed from the China Conservation and Research Center for the Giant Panda in Chengdu and were flown to Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport aboard a Federal Express charter aircraft known as “Panda Express,” landing at approximately 7:00 a.m. local time. The arrangement is based on a new 10-year giant panda conservation cooperation agreement between the zoo and the China Wildlife Conservation Association. The pandas' primary role in Atlanta will be breeding, supporting the maintenance of a giant panda population that conservation organizations assess as “vulnerable.” The pair has entered the zoo's newly completed panda complex and is currently in a biosecurity quarantine area. They are not yet available for public viewing. The zoo said it would announce details about the new habitat and public visiting times in the coming weeks.

## Arrival Time and Transportation

The pandas departed Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport on the morning of September 27, 2026. The charter flight took approximately 16 hours and crossed the International Date Line. After arriving in Atlanta, they were transported from the airport to the zoo in a police-escorted convoy. The pandas were unloaded from their Federal Express transport containers and moved into the facility. Zoo Atlanta President and CEO Raymond B. King said in a news statement that it was an exciting day for the zoo and a historic moment for the city of Atlanta, the state of Georgia, and the wider region. The pandas' names have specific meanings: Ping Ping represents a wish for a calm and peaceful life, while Fu Shuang's name comes from “Fu Fu” and signifies happiness. Both pandas previously lived at the China Conservation and Research Center for the Giant Panda in Chengdu, a major center for panda conservation, breeding, and research in China.

## Nature and Background of the Agreement

The panda transfer is based on an updated agreement announced by the zoo in April 2026. It established a new giant panda conservation partnership between Zoo Atlanta and the China Wildlife Conservation Association. Under the agreement, Atlanta became one of three zoos in the United States with giant pandas. China is providing Ping Ping and Fu Shuang to Zoo Atlanta on a 10-year loan, continuing Beijing's long-standing tradition of “panda diplomacy.” Panda diplomacy is often viewed as a sign of friendship in U.S.-China relations. This transfer took place shortly after high-level interactions between the two countries. Chinese President Xi Jinping had said during a visit to the White House that two pandas would be sent to Zoo Atlanta within days, describing giant pandas as messengers of friendship between China and the United States. The transfer arrangements had largely been completed in April, and Xi formally announced the arrival schedule during his White House visit. However, the pandas' arrival was not accompanied by major policy breakthroughs on AI, trade, Taiwan, or the war in Iran. Those issues had been discussed in closed-door conversations during a three-day Washington summit the previous week, but no substantive progress was achieved.

## Quarantine Arrangements and Public Viewing

After arriving at the zoo, the pandas will spend approximately one month in the biosecurity quarantine area of the panda complex as part of standard procedures to confirm their health and help them adapt to the new environment. They will not be open to public viewing during this period. The zoo has not announced a specific public exhibition date, saying only that it will release more information about the new habitat and visiting schedule in the coming weeks. The zoo had previously said it spent the past year renovating and preparing the pandas' enclosure. The public will need to wait until the quarantine period ends and the zoo makes an official announcement before visiting.

## Practical Significance for Different Groups

For Zoo Atlanta members, visitors, and the local community, the pandas' arrival ends a two-year gap and restores a panda exhibition tradition that the zoo has maintained since 1999. The zoo said it would share the upcoming excitement with members, visitors, the city, and the community. For people working in animal conservation and breeding, the central goal of the partnership is to support the panda population through pairing and breeding, because the species is currently assessed as vulnerable by conservation groups. For observers of U.S.-China relations, the transfer is viewed as a continuation of panda diplomacy following high-level talks, but it does not change the fact that no breakthroughs were achieved on several policy issues. For zoo operations, construction of the new facilities and a year of preparation are largely complete. The next steps are to manage the quarantine period and arrange public viewing after it ends.

## What to Wait for and What to Do Next

The public should wait for the zoo's official announcement in the coming weeks, which will specify the new habitat and when the pandas will be available to visitors. The pandas are currently in quarantine and cannot be viewed for approximately one month. After quarantine, the zoo will confirm their health and adaptation before arranging public exhibitions. People interested in the conservation partnership should note that the 10-year agreement between Zoo Atlanta and the China Wildlife Conservation Association was announced in April; the pandas' arrival is its concrete implementation. The next developments to watch include the zoo's visitor arrangements, the pandas' health and adaptation after quarantine, and progress on breeding under the agreement.

title_en: U.S. and China Cut Tariffs on $60 Billion in Nonsensitive Goods, Launch AI Dialogue, and Extend Truce into January
body_en_md:
On September 25, 2026, Chinese President Xi Jinping concluded a three-day state visit to the United States. The two countries reached an eight-point consensus. Its central elements include each side reducing tariffs to most-favored-nation levels on $30 billion of nonsensitive goods from the other country, establishing an AI safety communication channel and launching a first special dialogue, extending the existing trade truce through January 10, 2027, and confirming that the two leaders will meet again during the November APEC summit in Shenzhen and the December G20 summit in Miami. This was the first state visit to the United States by a Chinese president in 11 years and the second in-person meeting between the two leaders since the Beijing summit in May 2026. The consensus focused on de-escalating trade tensions and opening communication on AI governance, without breakthrough arrangements on the most sensitive issues between the two countries.

## Scope of Tariff Reductions and Implementation Arrangements

According to a White House fact sheet and a statement from China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the tariff reductions are reciprocal. Each side's list covers $30 billion in goods, for a combined total of $60 billion. All affected products are classified as “nonsensitive” and do not include semiconductors, advanced manufacturing, or other core areas subject to controls by the two countries. The U.S. list of exports to China includes agricultural products, seafood, raw timber and wood products, cosmetics, and medical devices. China's list of exports to the United States includes small household appliances, toys, holiday decorations, and child safety seats.

Multiple media reports said the two sides would reduce tariffs on these goods to most-favored-nation levels. The plan had first been proposed during the Beijing summit in May 2026 and was negotiated under the leadership of U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Trade Representative Jamieson Greer. It was finalized during this visit. The two countries have not yet publicly disclosed the specific effective date of the tariff reductions. The relevant arrangements will be announced separately by their customs and trade authorities.

## Establishment of an AI Dialogue Mechanism and Its Timeline

In addition to tariff reductions, the two sides agreed to establish a new AI safety communication channel to address AI-related emergencies and to launch a bilateral dialogue on AI risks and benefits. The first round of talks is scheduled for November 2026. Reports said the mechanism was established against the background of pressure on the Trump administration to regulate AI domestically. Although Trump had previously publicly described AI risks as a “hoax,” the administration had recently established an “AI task force” in response to calls for action. Agreeing to a dialogue mechanism with China is intended to avoid strategic miscalculation as AI technology develops. The consensus did not disclose the specific topics to be covered, but analysis generally expects them to include AI governance rules, technical standards, and risk prevention.

## Extension of the Trade Truce and Further Negotiations

The two sides also confirmed that the existing trade truce would be extended from its originally scheduled expiration date of November 10, 2026, to January 10, 2027, providing an additional two months to negotiate a broader trade agreement. They also agreed to establish a new bilateral trade council to carry forward the results of trade negotiations held in Kuala Lumpur in 2026. Regarding future leader-level meetings, both sides explicitly said they would attend summits hosted by the other country. Trump will attend the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China, in November, and Xi Jinping will attend the G20 summit in Miami, United States, in December. This would be the first visit to the United States by a Chinese president in 11 years. The two meetings are regarded as key opportunities to test whether the consensus will be implemented.

## Differences in the Consensus and Issues Left Unaddressed

Although both sides announced an eight-point consensus, the lists they publicly disclosed differ significantly. China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs introduced language calling for a “constructive and strategic stable China-U.S. relationship based on mutual respect, fairness and justice, and equality and mutual benefit.” Compared with the “constructive and strategic stability” wording used at the May 2026 Beijing summit, the new formulation adds “mutual respect, fairness and justice, and equality and mutual benefit” as introductory qualifications.

The U.S. list included two additional points not mentioned by China. First, it called on China to impose the maximum penalties on the 21 Chinese nationals arrested in August 2026 for manufacturing and trafficking fentanyl precursor chemicals to North America, encouraging the use of the death penalty. Second, it called on China to increase refined petroleum production to stabilize global supply. In addition, the most sensitive areas between the two countries—including U.S. technology sanctions against China, Taiwan, and the South China Sea—were absent from the consensus list. This indicates that the negotiations focused on de-escalating a limited set of issues and did not resolve the core disagreements in bilateral relations.

The practical effects of the consensus cover four groups. First are importers and exporters dealing in the listed agricultural products, seafood, wood products, cosmetics, medical devices, small appliances, toys, holiday decorations, and child safety seats. They should closely monitor announcements from the two countries' customs authorities on when tariff reductions take effect and adjust shipping and purchasing schedules in advance. If the reductions are implemented, exporters may contact overseas customers early to gain market share, while importers may benefit from lower purchasing costs. Goods not included on the lists remain subject to existing tariff policies, so businesses should not assume broader reductions.

The second group is people working in AI, including technology companies and research institutions. They should watch for policy signals from the first round of AI dialogue in November and review compliance requirements in advance to reduce regulatory risks. The third group is ordinary consumers. Prices of imported goods on the lists may decline in the future, but the actual reductions will depend on how much companies pass on to customers. Consumers should not expect major price cuts automatically.

For market and policy observers, two dates are particularly important. The first is the meeting between the two leaders during the November 2026 APEC summit in Shenzhen, which will test their willingness to implement the consensus. The second is January 10, 2027, when the trade truce expires. If the two sides fail to reach a broader trade agreement, existing tariff policies may return, and affected businesses should prepare contingency plans in advance. The first implementation of the AI dialogue mechanism will also be an important indicator of the direction of technological engagement between the two countries. (Approximately 2,100 Chinese characters in the original.)

title_en: Control Resonant Adds New Game++ and Photo Mode, Letting Players Replay and Capture the Action
body_en_md:
Control Resonant was officially released on September 24, 2026, for PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S. A macOS version was scheduled to follow later in 2026. After the game's release, Remedy Entertainment confirmed that it would add New Game++ mode and Photo Mode. The two additions are intended, respectively, to give players who have completed the game a reason to replay it and to provide tools for capturing and sharing in-game images. For people just starting the game, the current priorities are understanding its structure, known performance issues, differences among platforms and editions, and possible changes from future updates.

## Release Date and Platform Plans

Control Resonant is an action role-playing game developed and published by Remedy Entertainment. It builds on the setting of the 2019 game Control and was released on September 24, 2026, for PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S. The macOS version was scheduled to arrive later in the same year. Both digital and physical editions were available. The physical editions for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S were scheduled for October 15, 2026.

The Deluxe Edition offered 48-hour early access, exclusively on PlayStation 5, beginning September 22, 2026. Some players could therefore enter the game two days before its official release. The PC version was released through Steam and the Epic Games Store. Console availability covered PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, and GeForce NOW also supported the game on launch day.

## Changes to the Story and Gameplay

The protagonist is Dylan Faden, brother of Jesse Faden, the protagonist of the previous game. He was once a prisoner of the Bureau. The story centers on a new form of “Resonance,” alongside the previously introduced Hiss and Mold, which together reshape Manhattan's urban landscape. Buildings can appear inverted or rotated by 90 or 180 degrees, turning rooftops into walkable ground. For players unfamiliar with the previous game's setting, Remedy included a recap video at the beginning.

The gameplay differs significantly from the previous title. Remedy removed the shooting-centered mechanics of the earlier game and shifted the focus to melee combat. The design draws on Devil May Cry 2, Devil May Cry 3, and works by PlatinumGames. Its overall style is closer to an action game such as Bayonetta, while retaining the world and atmosphere of the Control series. The main weapon, “Aberrant,” is a transforming melee weapon. The game uses a zone-based structure rather than a fully open world, and Remedy described it as its largest work to date.

The main story takes approximately 30 hours to complete, twice the length of the previous game. Completing 100% of the content can take up to 50 hours. Players can pause combat in “the Gap,” Dylan's mental space, by holding down on the directional pad. It can be used to upgrade talents, switch abilities, practice in an arena, and craft artifacts. As the world grows in scale, this space becomes increasingly important, but it can also be easy to overlook.

## Confirmed Performance and Visual Issues

At launch, Remedy confirmed performance problems with AMD graphics cards. The PC version also received outside assessments of its visuals and performance. NVIDIA said on its blog that Control Resonant supports path tracing and automatically activates DLSS Ray Reconstruction when the “Ray Tracing Preset: Very High” setting is enabled, improving path-traced image quality and increasing frame rates. For players seeking higher frame rates, dynamic multi-frame generation allows frame generation of up to 6x or adjustment of the multiplier according to the current scene to reach a player-selected frame-rate target.

On specific hardware, a GeForce RTX 5090 can reach up to 320 frames per second with very-high-quality path tracing, while the GeForce RTX 5080 can be boosted to 220 frames per second. These performance levels are suitable for 120Hz and 240Hz 4K OLED displays. Digital Foundry said in its review that the PC version offered excellent scalability and good visual performance.

Performance problems were not limited to a particular graphics-card brand. Some players reported that Performance Mode generally maintained around 60 frames per second while exploring the semi-open world, but dropped below 50 fps during encounters with large numbers of enemies. In one boss fight, the frame rate fell into the low 50s when an enemy spewed lava. The lock-on system was also criticized: Dylan could suddenly swing at nearby enemies even when the player had clearly locked onto a target, and the camera could turn unpredictably when an enemy left the screen, interrupting combos and combat rhythm. Some players chose not to use lock-on until a patch was released. Remedy issued a hotfix on launch day that addressed some of the main complaints, easing several of the initial criticisms.

## Design Details and Points for Players to Note

Control Resonant has fast-paced combat and a melee system with considerable depth. Different builds allow players to adopt a variety of play styles. Dylan has movement abilities including jumping, gliding, midair dashing, and accelerated running. Once mastered, these abilities can create a strong sense of momentum. The visual design and world-building received broad praise, and the story continues Remedy's characteristic surreal style.

The game also has clear shortcomings. Enemy variety is limited, some early bosses are difficult, and the amount of visual information during combat can make it hard to read the situation quickly. Guidance on upgrades and abilities is sometimes unclear, making it difficult for new players to establish priorities. Some players found the map confusing, while others considered the design acceptable and felt that players needed to unlock the different map areas gradually.

For specific game mechanics, players can look up solutions to power-line puzzles, advice on whether to consume Mold, details the game does not clearly explain, and information about skill acquisition and locations. These are in-game operational details that may be useful to people who have started playing or plan to explore more deeply. The game also includes a karaoke sequence called “The Party Never Stops,” for which answers are available. Composer Petri Alanko said in an interview that the lack of hope and strength in the game's atmosphere affected him emotionally during the creative process and forced him to pause. This also reflects the intensity of the game's atmosphere.

The directors deliberately chose not to use yellow paint in the game. The creative team also discussed the “reverse symmetry” created by replacing Jesse with Dylan as the new protagonist. These choices indicate that Control Resonant is not simply an extension of the previous game; it makes substantial changes to both gameplay and narrative focus.

## What New Game++ and Photo Mode Mean

New Game++ is aimed at players who have already completed the game and want to experience its content again. Modes of this kind generally involve higher difficulty, additional challenges, or options related to unlocking and replaying content. They suit players who want to test their skills and builds further after becoming familiar with the game. Photo Mode lets players adjust images and capture specific moments in the game, making it useful for saving memorable scenes or sharing screenshots. For people who have already bought and played the game, these two additions increase its replay value and opportunities for creative expression after completion.

## What to Wait for and What to Do Next

If you plan to buy the game or already own it, first confirm your platform and edition. Digital and physical editions did not have exactly the same release dates. Deluxe Edition early access was exclusive to PlayStation 5 and began on September 22, 2026. macOS users need to wait for the later release scheduled for 2026. PC players can purchase through Steam or the Epic Games Store, while console players should look to PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.

For PC players, especially those using AMD graphics cards, performance problems were confirmed at launch, so subsequent patches are worth monitoring. Lock-on and frame-rate fluctuations were also discussed among players. Remedy released a hotfix on launch day that addressed some major problems, but this does not mean every issue has been resolved. Performance Mode can generally maintain 60 fps during exploration but may drop frames in heavy encounters. Players sensitive to frame rates can watch for further optimization updates.

For veterans of the original Control, the changes in Control Resonant will be significant: the focus shifts from shooting to melee combat, the pace is faster, and the world changes from the previous game's enclosed spaces to a zone-based design with a semi-open-world feel. The main story takes about 30 hours and a 100% completion run about 50 hours, so players with limited time may want to define their goals in advance. New players can use the recap video at the beginning to understand the previous game's background, but prior experience is not mandatory to play this title independently.

New Game++ and Photo Mode are post-launch additions worth watching for players who have finished or are close to finishing the game. Those who want to continue playing after completion or capture in-game images may find both features useful. Players more concerned about performance and stability should focus on future patches, particularly further optimization for AMD graphics cards and frame-rate performance.

Overall, Control Resonant is an action role-playing game released on September 24, 2026, starring Dylan Faden, with a story and gameplay that differ substantially from the previous title. After release, Remedy confirmed the addition of New Game++ and Photo Mode. The game has also had known issues involving AMD graphics-card performance, the lock-on system, and frame-rate fluctuations, as well as a launch-day hotfix. Players can decide whether to buy it, pursue 100% completion, and use New Game++ and Photo Mode after finishing it based on their platform, hardware, and gaming goals.

title_en: Cooper Leads Whatley by 11 Points as North Carolina Senate Race Enters Final 40 Days
body_en_md:
North Carolina's 2026 U.S. Senate election has entered its final 40 days before Election Day. Polling from several organizations shows Democratic candidate and former governor Roy Cooper continuing to lead Republican candidate and former Republican National Committee chairman Michael Whatley. The margin varies among polls, ranging from 5 to 15 percentage points, but no publicly released poll shows Whatley ahead. The campaign is focused on the cost of living, energy bills, healthcare costs, transgender issues, and the record of recovery after Hurricane Helene. Both candidates have repeatedly attacked the other's positions and record at their respective events.

## Polling Data and Sample Details

An AARP poll conducted September 17–20 found that 53% of respondents said they definitely or probably supported Cooper, or leaned toward voting for him on Election Day, while 42% expressed the same level of support for Whatley. Another 1% supported “another candidate,” and 5% were undecided. The poll surveyed 1,115 likely voters and had a margin of error of plus or minus 2.9 percentage points.

A YouGov poll showed Cooper leading by 11 points, with 52% support compared with 41% for Whatley. Cooper's advantage was more pronounced among independent voters: 58% supported Cooper and 33% supported Whatley, while 9% of independents were undecided or supported another candidate. Newsweek reported that Cooper's performance among independents reversed Trump's earlier margin of support by 29 percentage points.

A poll by a North Carolina news organization showed Cooper leading Whatley 51% to 41%. Another 2% chose a different candidate and 5.4% were undecided. Among voters firmly aligned with a party, Cooper received support from 95% of Democrats, while Whatley received support from 88% of Republicans. Unaffiliated voters favored Cooper by 21 points. The gender gap was substantial: Cooper led by 19 points among women but trailed by 2 points among men. Among voters under 45, Cooper led by 39 points; among those aged 45 and older, Whatley held a narrow 2-point lead. Cooper led in every region of the state except eastern North Carolina, where Whatley was ahead. Among the 5.4% who were undecided, follow-up questions found that 2.2 percentage points leaned toward Whatley, 0.3 points leaned toward Cooper, and the remaining 2.8% had no preference. After allocating those leaners, the race stood at Cooper 52% and Whatley 44%.

A High Point poll showed Cooper leading Whatley 50% to 42%. A Quantus Insights poll put Cooper's lead at 5 points. A carolinajournal.com report said Cooper's lead had widened to 15 points in September 2026. An Elon University poll also showed Cooper maintaining a double-digit lead. WUNC News reported that Whatley criticized a poll showing Cooper with a large lead, calling it a “garbage poll.” A poll reported by WCNC showed Cooper ahead by 8 points.

## Campaign Timeline and Candidate Events

With 40 days remaining before the 2026 general election, both candidates have intensified their attacks at campaign events. Whatley held an event at a private Christian school in Pittsboro, where he criticized Cooper's support for transgender issues, including allowing transgender women to participate in women's sports. Cooper vetoed a bill in 2023 that would have prohibited such participation, but Republican state legislators overrode his veto and enacted the ban. Whatley also pointed out that Cooper vetoed three anti-LGBTQ bills in 2023 that legislators later enacted by overriding his veto. They included the Fairness in Women's Sports Act, which prohibits transgender female athletes from participating on girls' high-school and college sports teams; the Parents' Rights Act, which prohibits instruction on gender identity or sexual orientation in grades K–4 and requires schools to notify parents when children change their names or pronouns; and House Bill 808, which restricts gender-affirming care for minors.

Cooper held an event at a tobacco receiving station in Wilson, where he spoke with local farmers and criticized Whatley for supporting President Donald Trump's tariff policies and the war with Iran, arguing that those policies had raised costs. Cooper's economic plan includes lowering electricity and utility bills. He said electricity costs in North Carolina had risen 22% since 2020. His proposals include ensuring that data centers pay the full cost of the electricity they consume so that those costs are not passed on to consumers; encouraging major technology companies to build their own energy sources to reduce utility costs for consumers; prohibiting utility companies from disconnecting service during dangerously hot or cold weather; and modernizing the power grid. In February, Duke Energy had asked customers to conserve electricity because the grid was under strain in cold weather. Whatley added an energy-and-economy section to his website, saying: “America's economic strength depends on reliable, affordable energy and reining in reckless spending in Washington. By practicing fiscal responsibility and unleashing American energy, we can empower American workers, create high-paying jobs, achieve energy independence, and build lasting prosperity for every American.”

## Controversial Issues and Policy Comparisons

The candidates also differ on healthcare. Cooper has proposed a series of healthcare measures, including preventing surprise medical bills, designating emergency ground ambulance services as an essential health benefit, capping annual out-of-pocket prescription costs, requiring hospitals to automatically enroll eligible patients in charity care, lowering drug and medical costs to prevent medical debt, and ensuring price transparency. Whatley has emphasized fiscal responsibility and unleashing American energy. His website says that fiscal responsibility and expanding American energy would empower workers, create high-paying jobs, and achieve energy independence.

The candidates have also clashed over recovery from Hurricane Helene. CBS17.com reported a dispute between Whatley and Cooper over their records on Helene recovery in the North Carolina Senate race.
